say:1:1460460001:1.text: I am the chosen one! Even dragons bow before me! I am invincible!
say:1:1460460001:1.source_cn: 我就是真正的英雄！龙也臣服在我的剑下！我所向无敌！

say:2:1460460002:1.text: Are you Bona's brother? Your sister just—
say:2:1460460002:1.source_cn: 你是珀娜的哥哥吗？你妹妹刚刚——

say:3:1460460003:1.text: Ah, my princess! With your blessing, I shall conquer the continent!
say:3:1460460003:1.source_cn: 啊，公主啊，只要有你的祝福，我愿意征服整个大陆！

say:5:1460460005:1.text: Uh, I think his case might be worse than ours.
say:5:1460460005:1.source_cn: 呃，他的毛病可能比我们更严重一点。

say:6:1460460006:1.text: We just daydream about going to the surface—imagine some battles, a few victories, maybe what the scenery's like up there. That's about it.
say:6:1460460006:1.source_cn: 我们只是幻想去地面上冒险，最多也只是想象下战斗啦胜利啦...

say:7:1460460007:1.text: But he really thinks he's already made it. Like he's gone on this epic adventure and come back a great hero or something...
say:7:1460460007:1.source_cn: 但他好像认为自己已经冒险成功，如今就是了不起的大英雄了……

say:9:1460460008:1.text: I will forge a new future for Sal'thorin! I am the hero!
say:9:1460460008:1.source_cn: 我，将为萨洛克兰带来全新的未来！我就是真正的英雄！

say:10:1460460009:1.text: And he's not the only one. Some kids even believe they're Indris' alternate personas or whatever...
say:10:1460460009:1.source_cn: 我哥哥这样还好，还有其他的哥哥姐姐幻想自己就是因度厄大...

say:11:1460460010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.

say:13:1460460011:1.text: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.
say:13:1460460011:1.source_cn: 嗯，我还记得你当时怎么把妮艾从妄想中唤回的。
say:13:1460460011:1.male: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.
say:13:1460460011:1.female: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.

say:14:1460460012:1.text: Though this one looks like a much tougher nut to crack...
say:14:1460460012:1.source_cn: 不过这孩子看起来病得更严重，不知道还能不能劝得回来啊……
say:14:1460460012:1.male: Though this one looks like a much tougher nut to crack...
